# cloudflare_zero_trust_dlp_proximity_validator (Data Source)

Accepted Permissions

- `Zero Trust Read`
- `Zero Trust Write`

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudflare_zero_trust_dlp_proximity_validator" "example_zero_trust_dlp_proximity_validator" {
  account_id = "account_id"
  validator_id = "182bd5e5-6e1a-4fe4-a799-aa6d9a6ab26e"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String)
- `validator_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) A name for this validator, at most 50 characters.
- `referenced_by` (Attributes) What currently uses a validator. Deleting a validator that is still in use returns `409`, so
check this first.

Read-only. A validator is attached or detached by updating the detection entry that uses it, not
by writing this back. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--referenced_by))
- `updated_at` (String)
- `words` (Attributes Set) The words that raise confidence when found near a match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--words))

<a id="nestedatt--referenced_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `referenced_by`

Read-Only:

- `entries` (Attributes List) The detection entries using this validator, ordered by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--referenced_by--entries))
- `entry_count` (Number) Number of detection entries this validator is attached to.

<a id="nestedatt--referenced_by--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `referenced_by.entries`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String) The type of a detection entry.
Available values: "custom", "custom_prompt_topic", "predefined", "integration", "exact_data", "document_fingerprint", "word_list".



<a id="nestedatt--words"></a>
### Nested Schema for `words`

Read-Only:

- `weight` (String) How much a word contributes to a match's confidence when it is found nearby.

Separate from a profile's high/medium/low confidence threshold: this describes how telling the
word is, not how confident the resulting match is.
Available values: "strong", "moderate", "weak".
- `word` (String) The word or phrase to look for. Must contain 1–128 characters and is matched
case-insensitively.
